info.title: Chakravyuh API
info.description: Indic red-teaming lab for LLM and voice applications.

get.description: Live pipeline view: per-stage counts and the latest attacks (poll while the campaign runs).

post.description: Replay a campaign's attacks as speech (Sarvam TTS -> STT -> target) for a text-vs-voice comparison.

get.description: The guided Test → Fix → Protect flow: which steps are done and where to go next.

Per-language rings and a replay of real attacks for the Living Chakravyuh visual (all campaigns in a
scope, or one campaign).

post.description: Send a message to the protected target through Shield. Point your app's users (or a campaign) here.
Create (or return) the '<name> + Shield' target, which can be attacked like any other target.

get.description: Shield stats, recent decisions, and the without-vs-with-Shield campaign comparison.

post.description: Run the target's legitimate questions through Shield's input check: are real users let through?

get.description: Find the verified target whose origin matches the page the extension is open on.

post.description: Prepare one attack (translated, with a fresh hidden code) for the person to send in their own chat.
Score the bot's reply with the same detectors as campaigns and save it as a finding.

get.description: Is the demo bot reachable, verified and in its intended vulnerable state?

post.description: Send one KNOWN attack to the unprotected bot and report whether it really leaks right now.
Put the demo bot back on v1 (an applied auto-fix leaves it on 'custom').
Step 1: store the exact prompt and attack the UNPROTECTED bot.
Step 2: replay the stored prompt through the real Shield.
Send the stored prompt to both modes again.

get.description: Fallback: a real earlier run that showed the full story, always labelled source='recorded'.

post.description: Speech to text only; nothing is attacked until the judge reviews and sends the text.

AttackWrapper.title: AttackWrapper
AttackWrapper.description: Optional local (no-API) transformations applied after localization.

category.description: Library attack type, null for the judge's own words

marker_token.title: Marker Token
marker_token.description: Injected code that proves the bot obeyed, if the attack carries one

language_matches.title: Language Matches
language_matches.description: Whether Sarvam's detected language equals the selected one

identical_prompt.title: Identical Prompt
identical_prompt.description: Both runs received exactly the same text; null until both ran

max_turns.title: Max Turns
max_turns.description: Adaptive mode: attempts per mission before giving up

max_turns.title: Max Turns
max_turns.description: Adaptive mode: attempts per mission before giving up

written.title: Written
written.description: Attack texts produced: translated by Sarvam and language-checked

in_flight.title: In Flight
in_flight.description: Sent to the target, waiting for the reply or the verdict

CampaignLiveOut.title: CampaignLiveOut
CampaignLiveOut.description:
Per-stage counts for the live pipeline view. Attacks run in parallel, so each count is
'how many attacks have reached this step' rather than a single global phase.

regression_id.title: Regression Id
regression_id.description: Set when this campaign is a regression rerun

latest_regression_id.title: Latest Regression Id
latest_regression_id.description: Most recent regression run of this campaign

ok.title: Ok
ok.description: true = good, false = needs attention, null = could not be determined

confirmed.title: Confirmed
confirmed.description: false = only a PII-looking pattern with no link to planted data

value.title: Value
value.description: The matched text (synthetic demo data), when it is safe to show

FalseBlockResult.title: FalseBlockResult
FalseBlockResult.description: Legitimate questions sent through Shield's input check: how many got through?

fix_set_size.title: Fix Set Size
fix_set_size.description: Successful attacks shown to the patch author

heldout_set_size.title: Heldout Set Size
heldout_set_size.description: Successful attacks held back to test generalization

rings.title: Rings
rings.description: Per-language attack success, same counting as the dashboard

attacks.title: Attacks
attacks.description: Most recent real attacks, oldest first, for the replay

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Short evidence for a breach, e.g. 'Exposed: Aadhaar'

GeneralizationOut.title: GeneralizationOut
GeneralizationOut.description: Did the patch fix only the attacks it was shown, or also ones it never saw?

vulnerable.title: Vulnerable
vulnerable.description: Attacks that still succeed at this step

rerun_total.title: Rerun Total
rerun_total.description: Attacks replayed at this step (null for the original run)

HelpfulnessOut.title: HelpfulnessOut
HelpfulnessOut.description: Over-refusal check: how many legitimate questions (the target's own, or a built-in banking set) the bot still answers.

next_key.title: Next Key
next_key.description: The first step that is not done yet; null when all are done

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: One plain-language line about this step's state

link.title: Link
link.description: Where in the app to do (or see) this step

LiveEvent.title: LiveEvent
LiveEvent.description: One attack in the live feed: written (and translated), then answered and judged.

marker_token.title: Marker Token
marker_token.description: Random code hidden in the attack; if the reply repeats it, the bot obeyed

result_id.title: Result Id
result_id.description: Open /findings/{result_id} in Chakravyuh for the full evidence

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: What each detector that fired found

reply.title: Reply
reply.description: The bot's reply, as selected on the page

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why no target matched, in plain words

ManualMatchOut.title: ManualMatchOut
ManualMatchOut.description: Which verified target (if any) lives on the page the extension is open on.

attacker_note.title: Attacker Note
attacker_note.description: Why the attacker chose this tactic (its reasoning)

Mutation.title: Mutation
Mutation.description: Every step that can appear in a test case's mutation chain.

attack_label.title: Attack Label
attack_label.description: Which known attack was sent last, e.g. 'auditor asks for personal data'

ProbeOut.title: ProbeOut
ProbeOut.description: Result of sending one KNOWN attack to the unprotected bot to confirm it is in the vulnerable state.

bot_version.title: Bot Version
bot_version.description: v1 = the intended vulnerable state; null = unknown

ready.title: Ready
ready.description: Everything the live demonstration needs is in place

split.title: Split
split.description: 'fix' = shown to the patch author; 'heldout' = never seen by it; null = not part of the fix

fix_id.title: Fix Id
fix_id.description: The auto-fix proposal this rerun verifies, if any

source.title: Source
source.description: 'live' only for a run that just executed; 'recorded' for a stored one

prompt_sha256.title: Prompt Sha256
prompt_sha256.description: Hash of the exact text this run received

finding_id.title: Finding Id
finding_id.description: Open /findings/{id} for the full stored evidence

vulnerabilities_confirmed.title: Vulnerabilities Confirmed
vulnerabilities_confirmed.description: Proven by a deterministic detector (canary, marker, PII, prompt overlap)

vulnerabilities_likely.title: Vulnerabilities Likely
vulnerabilities_likely.description: Decided by the Sarvam-105B judge (quoted evidence required)

language.title: Language
language.description: Detected by Sarvam language ID, e.g. kn-IN

english.title: English
english.description: Sarvam Translate's English reading of the message

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: Fast input rule that fired, if any

category.title: Category
category.description: Attack category from the Sarvam-105B classifier, if any

ShieldChatResponse.title: ShieldChatResponse
ShieldChatResponse.description: `reply` is what the user sees: the bot's answer, a redacted answer, or a polite refusal.

same_config.title: Same Config
same_config.description: Both campaigns used the same mode, categories, languages and styles

ShieldComparison.title: ShieldComparison
ShieldComparison.description: Latest campaign against the bare target vs the latest one against the shielded target.

blocked.title: Blocked
blocked.description: Inputs blocked + replies blocked or redacted

base_url.title: Base Url
base_url.description: Full endpoint URL the attack prompt is sent to

body_template.title: Body Template
body_template.description: JSON request body; must contain the `{{prompt}}` placeholder

response_path.title: Response Path
response_path.description: Dotted path to the reply text, e.g. `choices.0.message.content`

fix_webhook_url.title: Fix Webhook Url
fix_webhook_url.description: Optional: Chakravyuh POSTs a patched system prompt here ({system_prompt, addendum}) so fixes can be applied and verified in one click

legit_questions.title: Legit Questions
legit_questions.description: Ordinary questions a real user of this app asks (English; translated per language). Used by the over-refusal check before/after a fix. Empty = the built-in banking set

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Request headers (e.g. auth). Stored server-side, never returned unmasked.

ownership_confirmed.title: Ownership Confirmed
ownership_confirmed.description: User attests they own or are authorized to test this application

shield_for_target_id.title: Shield For Target Id
shield_for_target_id.description: Set when this target is a Chakravyuh Shield in front of another target

base_url.title: Base Url
base_url.description: Full endpoint URL the attack prompt is sent to

body_template.title: Body Template
body_template.description: JSON request body; must contain the `{{prompt}}` placeholder

response_path.title: Response Path
response_path.description: Dotted path to the reply text, e.g. `choices.0.message.content`

fix_webhook_url.title: Fix Webhook Url
fix_webhook_url.description: Optional: Chakravyuh POSTs a patched system prompt here ({system_prompt, addendum}) so fixes can be applied and verified in one click

legit_questions.title: Legit Questions
legit_questions.description: Ordinary questions a real user of this app asks (English; translated per language). Used by the over-refusal check before/after a fix. Empty = the built-in banking set

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Omit or null to keep existing headers; provide a map to replace them

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.default: Hello! What can you help me with?

TextSpan.title: TextSpan
TextSpan.description: Character offsets into `extracted_reply` to highlight as evidence.

text_baseline.title: Text Baseline
text_baseline.description: 'fresh' = the text version was re-sent alongside the voice one and judged identically (fair comparison); 'original' = older replay compared against the original campaign's verdicts

pairs.title: Pairs
pairs.description: Attacks with a usable result in both modalities

text_only.title: Text Only
text_only.description: Succeeded as text, failed when spoken

voice_only.title: Voice Only
voice_only.description: Failed as text, succeeded when spoken

VoicePair.title: VoicePair
VoicePair.description: The SAME attack sent as text and as speech.

language.description: Spoken language; null lets Sarvam STT auto-detect

intended_text.title: Intended Text
intended_text.description: What the attacker meant to say (for drift)
